page_title: DAR 0-1 HEI | Darmstadt v Heidenheim 28/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' Substitution. Jan-Niklas Beste leaves the pitch and is replaced by Florian Pick (Heidenheim).
90+2' Bastian Dankert sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
90+2' The Heidenheim players halt their celebrations as referee Bastian Dankert makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' 0 - 1 Nikola Dovedan (Heidenheim) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
85' Julian Justvan (Darmstadt) gathers the pass and without hesitation smashes a shot in from long range, but it goes high over the bar.

85' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Christian Kuhlwetter (Heidenheim) replaces Eren Dinkci.
80' Here is a change. Oscar Vilhelmsson is going off and Torsten Lieberknecht gives the last tactical orders to Gerrit Holtmann (Darmstadt).
79' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Emir Karic walks off the pitch to be replaced by Mathias Honsak (Darmstadt).
79' Marcel Schuhen leaps to intercept the corner kick from Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim).
77' Christoph Zimmermann (Darmstadt) wins the battle with the defender and plants a header goalwards from the corner, but his effort from around the penalty spot sails harmlessly past the right post.
77' Corner kick. Oscar Vilhelmsson (Darmstadt) is ready to send the ball into the box.

76' Oscar Vilhelmsson (Darmstadt) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Darmstadt.
73' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
73' The attendance for today's match is 17000.

73' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) evades several challenges inside the box and fires a shot in on goal, but that's a great block by the defender to stop an almost certain goal. Heidenheim have been awarded a corner kick.
70' Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
69' Frank Schmidt has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nikola Dovedan (Heidenheim) replacing Kevin Sessa.
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Denis Thomalla (Heidenheim) will replace Marvin Pieringer.
67' A cross from a corner kick by Heidenheim is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

66' Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) sends a direct shot in from a dangerously positioned free kick. The ball sails to the top left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a quick save to deny him. The linesman makes the right call and Darmstadt will have a corner.
66' Bastian Dankert blows the whistle, Norman Theuerkauf (Heidenheim) is penalised for a foul. Free kick. Darmstadt will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
63' It will be a substitution. Julian Justvan (Darmstadt) is ready to enter the pitch as Tobias Kempe walks off.
63' Norman Theuerkauf (Heidenheim) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
60' Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
60' Norman Theuerkauf (Heidenheim) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for a foul.
58' Marcel Schuhen is equal to the effort from the edge of the box by Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim), pushing the ball around the post to safety.
57' Heidenheim failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
56' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. The ball is out of play. Heidenheim win a corner kick.
56' Heidenheim quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

56' Heidenheim are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block. Heidenheim force their opponents to concede a corner.
55' Heidenheim take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
55' Heidenheim can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The ball goes behind for a corner. Heidenheim will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
52' Emir Karic (Darmstadt) has tested the patience of referee Bastian Dankert and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
52' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
49' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
47' The rebound finds Christoph Zimmermann (Darmstadt) in space inside the box, but his shot flies high over the bar. That was a promising chance!
47' Christoph Zimmermann (Darmstadt) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
47' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Darmstadt.

46' A rebound falls to Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) who knows what to do with it. He drills a low shot from the edge of the penalty box, but Kevin Muller anticipates his intention and denies him with a nice quick save.
46' Referee Bastian Dankert blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' A thunderous effort from long range by Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) goes well wide of the left post.
43' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Bastian Dankert had an easy-decision to make.
42' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar.
40' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
38' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) brings his opponent down. Bastian Dankert has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.

37' Close! A mistake by a defender gifts Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) a chance inside the box, but his efforts curls just around the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Darmstadt.
35' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marcel Schuhen intercepts the ball.
34' Christoph Klarer (Darmstadt) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
34' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
31' Emir Karic (Darmstadt) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post.
29' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) jumps into a tackle and Bastian Dankert signals a foul.
27' Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.

26' Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball down to the middle of the goal. Marcel Schuhen shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
26' Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
22' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Norman Theuerkauf (Heidenheim).
21' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
20' Total attempts – 1:3.
20' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) sends a cross into the box, but Marcel Schuhen comes off his line to gather the ball.
19' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.

17' What a chance that is! Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Darmstadt will have a goal kick.
16' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.

14' Heidenheim slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
13' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) was too forceful with his tackle and Bastian Dankert interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
10' A loose ball is pounced on by Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the top of the net, but Marcel Schuhen is alert and makes a comfortable save.
8' Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
5' Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just over the crossbar.
3' A clumsy foul by Oscar Vilhelmsson (Darmstadt) and Bastian Dankert blows his whistle.
1' A lofted cross from Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
1' The first half has just begun.
Heidenheim will kick the game off.
Bastian Dankert was nominated as the referee for this game.
